observations: Installed stdio_client takes only server/errlog and resolves a module-global _create_platform_compatible_process. No process_factory/startupinfo parameter is exposed.

Installed Windows creator calls AnyIO open_process, falls back to _create_windows_fallback_process on NotImplementedError, then executes original Job creation/assignment. AnyIO accepts startupinfo; fallback uses subprocess.Popen without it.

Existing project retain_mcp_stdio_process already accepts a stdio_module object and wraps its _create_platform_compatible_process attribute. Its capture/normal exception/cleanup contract can be reused with a PRIVATE module rather than installed stdio.

In tracked project src/tools, the bounded search found the capture hook but no active public Queue stdio_client callsite. Existing external/generated Queue seam is documented in native30-exact-birth-private-transfer-plan-2026-10-19.json; current C13/C14 factories were not read or changed.

recommendation.injected_owner: Construct once at future Queue bootstrap before App creation, from the actual private inherited-custody receiver. The constructor imports the real installed modules internally; a client cannot choose module/function objects or provide a JSON custody claim.
recommendation.binding_shape: BoundOwnedStdioV1 exposes private_stdio (a fresh ModuleType-like namespace) and stdio_client. No installed module is assigned, no sys.modules entry is replaced, and no existing session is rebound.
recommendation.minimal_code_binding: Reuse four existing dependency code objects with types.FunctionType in per-binding global dictionaries: the unwrapped stdio_client async generator, _create_platform_compatible_process, create_windows_process, and _create_windows_fallback_process. Copy defaults/kwdefaults/annotations as needed; require the observed top-level no-freevars/signatures and pinned dependency source. Wrap the rebound async generator with contextlib.asynccontextmanager. This does not copy or exec dependency source, vendor a package, or reimplement its transport/Job/shutdown logic.
private_dictionary_links: private_stdio.__dict__ is the actual globals dictionary for rebound stdio_client and platform creator. The existing capture hook's setattr(private_stdio, '_create_platform_compatible_process', wrapper) therefore affects ONLY this binding and is actually consulted by that client.
Only the private platform creator resolves create_windows_process to its private bound counterpart.

The private Windows creator receives a private AnyIO forwarding object whose open_process injects the already-created selective startupinfo into this exact expected command; every other API delegates unchanged. The installed utilities.anyio reference is never modified.

Its fallback resolves a private bound _create_windows_fallback_process. That function receives a private subprocess forwarding object whose Popen supplies startupinfo and close_fds=True for the exact same owned spawn. The installed subprocess/MCP references are unchanged.

Retain original _create_job_object/_maybe_assign_process_to_job/FallbackProcess and original shutdown helpers by reference. Keep the SAME original _process_jobs mapping by identity, not a copied replacement table: original cleanup must see the actual returned process's Job.
queue_callsite_sketch: actual_child = capture.require_generation()  # use actual existing capture API; not a JSON PID
# complete existing private parent/receiver verification; then original ClientSession(read_stream, write_stream)
recommendation.constructor_note: The sketch expresses injection ownership; production implementation must use the existing capture object's exact require_generation signature. It is not executable code or a new public API.
recommendation.source_contract: Version/source/code-identity guards run before creating a child. These hashes are dependency compatibility guards only; they never substitute for actual loaded Native DLL SHA or kernel custody evidence.

preserve_original_semantics.transport: Original stdio_client async-generator bytecode still creates streams/tasks, applies encoding, drains output, flushes writer, shields bounded shutdown, and cancels the group. None of this body is rewritten.
preserve_original_semantics.jobs: Original Windows creator performs its original Job creation/assignment; original cleanup sees the same returned process object and same original Job table. Do not hand-create or pop a second Job, detach Job ownership, or replace the library's stop helpers.
preserve_original_semantics.fallback: Keep the existing NotImplementedError fallback behavior by adding selective inheritance to BOTH original async and fallback creation paths. If future implementation cannot prove the fallback seam/signature, refuse optional custody before a child is created rather than silently spawning an unqualified resource receiver.
preserve_original_semantics.exceptions: OSError/ValueError/cancellation/creation errors retain original propagation and traceback code filenames. Guard failures are explicit private-binding failures; do not convert an unknown post-create failure into a second spawn, no-op, or retry. Original capture keeps the real child cleanup owner even when generation capture fails.
preserve_original_semantics.boundary_default: Missing/disabled custody or unsupported library qualification yields Hunknown and the prior ordinary transport before any owned spawn begins. Never retrofit an already-running session. After creation begins, keep the original error and normal cleanup path; do not create a replacement App under this API.

resource_and_concurrency_guards: The constructor accepts only the actual internal inherited-custody object with live exact target/file handles and a validated parent chain. CLI/env numbers locate resources; neither JSON nor source hashes authorize them.

Per-binding resource reservation is one-shot and tied to exact resolved command/args/environment/cwd. Do not reuse one holder to create two App receivers. Freeze request parameters before allocation; source mismatch is unavailable before CreateProcess.

Every new binding has disjoint stdio and utility globals/forwarding objects. No process-wide monkeypatch or global spawn lock is needed; running legacy sessions and unrelated AnyIO/Popen calls remain untouched.

The existing hook's global bookkeeping lock remains only its normal short dictionary guard, keyed by id(private_stdio). Two independent private bindings can be active concurrently; re-entering the SAME binding must refuse before spawning.

Only explicit inheritable owned target-read/file-lease/parent-query/root-revoke handles plus normal stdio handles enter STARTUPINFOEX. Require close_fds behavior, no runtime Game/job/control handles, no unrelated inheritable handles.

Do not release last sender DLL lease or mark transfer success until the actual receiver independently verifies parent pipe peer, exact FILETIME/image/liveness and held file identity/hash. This creator constructs a process, not a DTO.

On capture/adoption failure or cancellation, revoke the actual optional DTO/cache FIRST if one exists, then release owned handles through canonical owner cleanup. Unknown closes retain the owner-held resource for retry, never the borrowed target or pipe.

Actual App receiver and issuer stay M0/M7's unique typed contract. No second qualification seal/DTO is created by this binding. Exact-100ns candidate path and source_epoch dependency registration remain separate unfinished work.

maintenance_boundary.scope: Explicit compatibility adapter for the observed installed MCP, not a generic function-cloning framework. Bind only the four named top-level functions; no AST search, dependency-source rewriting, or arbitrary replacement maps.
maintenance_boundary.fail_closed: If __wrapped__/signatures/co_freevars/source pins/code links change, this optional owned binding is unavailable pending a targeted review; do not guess a new API or silently drop handles.
maintenance_boundary.exit_path: If a future MCP version exposes an owned process_factory/startupinfo seam, replace the private binding with that supported injection point after preserving the same capture/Job/shutdown evidence.
maintenance_boundary.evidence_limit: Only source-level compatibility is reviewed here. No private-namespace FunctionType binder was executed in this turn, and no concurrency/fallback/cancellation behavior is claimed passed.

future_minimum_software_validation_not_r: Two concurrent private bindings plus an untouched original session: disjoint globals/resources, original module/AnyIO/subprocess references unchanged, both actual child captures paired correctly.
Exercise original async path and original NotImplemented fallback with injected owned creators: exact selective startupinfo, same process object and original Job map, no unqualified fallback.
Original OSError/ValueError and cancellation before/after child return: no second spawn, original shutdown/Job cleanup and capture retain the exact child.
One-shot reuse and wrong command/custody refuse before creation; disabled/missing/unsupported binding does not issue DTO or interfere with ordinary root readiness.

Later one bounded owned mechanical run through the full bound stdio_client may qualify this adapter; current prototype's factory mechanics cannot substitute. No such run is authorized/executed by this design record.
